notes.title: Pre-Alpha update for closed testing version 0.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]The Update[/b]
The latest build of version 0.0.7 is currently available for all closed-testing participants.
It adds a new big playable map - Training Area where you can try out the core mechanics of the game, including FPV drone, Artillery, Driving, Building, and more.
Also, reworked suppression and shooting system committed to adding realism and unique experience.

Reworked soldiers looks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43662941/38ca664fe3def29750becd889f69d53f9067bd61.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43662941/e9fb56d98c9c3c2d9511650e7209aeab98730674.png[/img]

The next update will be considered Pre-alpha version 0.0.8 instead of the previous naming to correctly reflect the game state where the first digit means full release version, the second digit means early access version, and the third digit (Current) - pre-alpha version.

[b]The Demo[/b]
A New Public PvE demo on Steam will be available during the winter holidays! Further details will be published close to New Year's Eve. Stay tuned!

Join our Discord community to stay up to date with all updates - https://discord.gg/zmzkh7rdH3

notes.title: Vehicles arriving to the Demo with Day-One Patch!
notes.notes:
We collected a lot of useful feedback and bug reports, so Day-One patch with most bug fixes will be rolled out in the next couple of days. Also, It will deliver some new content, including drivable APCs - BMP-2 & BTR. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Emergency Hotfix for the Demo
notes.notes:
Fixed:

[list]
[*] Pause Menu bug in Tutorial
[*] Door in tutorial stabs player
[*] Ability to fly around in the main menu
[*] Fixed unable to use a tourniquet
[*] Resolution issues fixed
[/list]

Also, check the updated system specs for the Demo on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239670/Glory_to_the_Heroes/]Store Page[/url]! It was adjusted to more specifically reflect the hardware needed for the Demo.

notes.title: Major Alpha/Pre-Alpha Update 1.2 already available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43662941/423f20fc03510d9fab6daabff394c8af424bfd8f.png[/img]

Changes in v1.2:

• Major graphics and lighting overhaul
• Major performance improvements
• Mouse sensitivity issues fixed
• Character maximum movement speed decreased
• Fixed issues with weapons Scopes
• Brand-new character’s True First Person view model
• New aimed view models for all weapons
• RPG projectile trajectories improved
• Added material reactions to impacts for all surfaces
• New footsteps, gunshots, and reloading sounds added
• Improved realistic VFX of shooting and explosions 
• Full destruction system added
• Doors and Door opening system added
• New weapons: RPK-16 & Fort 14
• New collimator and holographic scopes added
• HUD overhaul (Ammo counter removed, added new compass and squad block)
• New tutorial level for ground forces added

notes.title: Alpha v1.1 Update already available for testers!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43662941/b58b7c56d0ee580e3ab532a8841e53389d5ba12a.png[/img]

Changes in Alpha 1.1:

• Improved day-night switching system
• Fixed collision bugs related to vehicles and character interaction
• Added new overhauled explosion and vehicles destruction effect
• Improved lighting quality 
• Reworked Vehicle - Vehicle and Player - Vehicle damage balance
• Added basic AI
• Added fortifications construction system
• Added player rag doll and self-damage
• Training Range - level design improvements
• Increased performance
• Improved shooting effect & removed too bright flashes
• Minor or rare bugs fixes
• Minor Main Menu overhaul

And some more minor things!
